title: Bloom punch: glow preset tuned for the Compatibility renderer
summary: One node that turns on strong, clean glow on the scene's current Environment (any look or your own WorldEnvironment): emissive materials and the sun bloom, ordinary lit surfaces stay crisp. Presets punch (default), soft, dreamy.
use_when: Neon, sci-fi, magic, pickups, lasers, lava, glowing crystals, night lights; any scene with emissive materials that should pop.
how_to_use: Instance res://starter/post-bloom-punch/bloom_punch.tscn anywhere in the scene (plain Node, script bloom_punch.gd). Set preset ('punch', 'soft', 'dreamy') and intensity_scale (0-3). It edits the active Environment one frame after start (after look packs apply). Things glow when their emission is bright: use StandardMaterial3D emission_enabled with emission_energy_multiplier 2-6. Compatibility threshold 0.75, Forward+ 1.1.
provenance: Made by Summer for the shelf

verified.notes: demo.tscn rendered in Compatibility and Forward+ on macOS (Metal, 1280x720) with no SCRIPT ERROR or shader errors; fresh_test (clean cloud project + preview stage) imports and renders in Compatibility with no errors. Not run in a real browser (WebGL2) or on the cloud's Linux/Mesa GL. Compatibility glow is tighter and dimmer than Forward+ at equal settings, so intensity is multiplied by 1.8 in Compatibility and the threshold is raised by 0.35 in Forward+. demo.tscn has demo-only lighting nodes. v1.1 (2026-10-03, owner rule: building blocks only): demo scene and demo scripts moved out; the remaining pieces are unchanged.
